title: Open the console from the portal (and what must not work)
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/sso-bookings.e2e.ts (first and last steps).

steps.title: Open the OTA in the portal
steps.body: Signed in to the portal, open your OTA's page.
steps.expect: **Open console** is shown for staff of an active OTA.

steps.title: Open console
steps.body: Press **Open console**. The hand-off page posts the one-time token to `/sso` by itself.
steps.expect: `/bookings` of this OTA; four `__Host-vx_*` cookies, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax; `document.cookie` is empty; a `staff.sign_in` row in `tenant_<key>.staff_actions`.

steps.title: Replay the hand-off
steps.body: Go back to the hand-off page and resubmit it (or replay the captured POST).
steps.expect: `401` page "This console link expired or was already used" with **Back to the portal**; no staff cookie set.

steps.title: Sign out
steps.expect: `/signed-out`; access, refresh and environment cookies gone; opening `/bookings` now goes to the portal's console page.
